item.title: Dem senators call to fund DHS after voting to block it 4 times amid shutdown fight
item.summary: Government shutdown continues over Department of Homeland Security funding as Democrats seek immigration enforcement reforms amid terror attacks.

item.title: American who fled Iran says citizens 'desperate' for freedom, praying for Islamic regime to fall
item.summary: Iranian American says citizens celebrate U.S. strikes on Iran, dancing near bomb sites and reportedly thanking America for targeting the regime's military sites.

item.title: Support for Israel drops as Democrats turn against key US ally: poll
item.summary: New poll reveals dramatic shift in American views of Israel, with just 32% holding positive opinions compared to 47% three years ago amid ongoing conflict.

item.title: Trump 'thrilled' as FCC chair warns news organizations to correct course or lose licenses
item.summary: Trump expresses support as FCC Chairman Brendan Carr calls for investigation into news organizations' broadcast licenses over alleged fake news coverage.

item.title: DHS nabs Afghan man admitted under Biden after conviction for exposing himself to minor
item.summary: An Afghan national let into the country by the Biden administration has been arrested by the Department of Homeland Security following a conviction for indecent exposure to a minor.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie update: Search for Savannah Guthrie's missing mother enters seventh week with no arrests
item.summary: Missing person case enters seventh week as authorities offer $1.2 million reward for Nancy Guthrie's safe return. Internet outage investigated in case.

item.title: Trump reveals ‘terminal’ diagnosis for sitting congressman, intervention from White House doctors
item.summary: President Donald Trump said White House doctors helped treat Rep. Neal Dunn, with the Florida Republican undergoing emergency surgery at Walter Reed.

item.title: Fired DHS chief Kristi Noem faces criminal referral from congressional Democrats
item.summary: Democrats accuse Kristi Noem of making "demonstrably false" statements to Congress regarding DHS contracts and Corey Lewandowski, weeks after her ousting by President Trump.

item.title: TSA pay bill unveiled as shutdown leaves agents unpaid, strains airport security
item.summary: House Republican Nick Langworthy unveils the Pay TSA Act to ensure TSA workers receive paychecks as the partial government shutdown hits the one-month mark.

item.title: Woman crushed to death under St. Patrick's Day parade float in front of crowds of spectators
item.summary: Kentucky woman dies after being dragged under float during Louisville St. Patrick's Day parade. Joan Pannuti, 50, reportedly fell when foot became caught.
